## Description

Verify that a `StackContainer` hosted in a tab that has not been selected yet
shows its first screen already laid out when the tab is selected for the first
time. The frame of a stack screen depends on its header, so it is known only
once the screen is laid out natively. Until it is applied, the screen content
is laid out for the whole area of the tab, so e.g. centered content sits too
low. The scenario guards against that layout being shown, i.e. against the
content jumping into place right after the stack screen appears.

## Note

- The jump, when present, lasts one or two frames. To judge it reliably, record
  the screen and step through the recording frame by frame around the tab
  switch.
- The first appearance happens once per stack. Each of the two stack tabs can
  be checked once; to repeat, leave the scenario and open it again.
- Known issue, Android: on the first selection of a stack tab one frame may
  show the tab without the stack screen (an empty area above the tab bar)
  before the screen appears. This scenario does not cover it.

## Steps

### Baseline

1. Launch the app and navigate to the **Stack in Tabs - stable first
   appearance** screen.

   - [ ] A tab bar with three items is visible: _Home_, _Stack A_, _Stack B_.
   - [ ] _Home_ is selected.

---

### First appearance

1. Start a screen recording and tap the _Stack A_ tab.

   - [ ] The stack screen is shown with the "Stack A" header, the "Top edge"
         bar directly below the header and the "Centered" bar further down.
   - [ ] In every frame that shows the stack screen, the "Centered" bar is
         where it is at rest. It does not move after the screen first appears.

2. Tap the _Stack B_ tab.

   - [ ] The stack screen is shown with the "Stack B" header and the same
         content layout as in First appearance step 1.
   - [ ] As in First appearance step 1, the "Centered" bar does not move after
         the screen first appears.

---

### Subsequent selections

1. Switch between the _Home_, _Stack A_ and _Stack B_ tabs a few times.

   - [ ] Each stack tab shows its content in the same place as before, without
         any movement.
